definition.name: Rebuilt Rust standard clocks and signed grants

steps.name: Verify standard source and executable ownership controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_rust_standard_clock_profile tools.tests.test_rust_standard_tls_profile tools.tests.test_rust_standard_sysroot_source tools.tests.test_rust_standard_sysroot_build tools.tests.test_rust_standard_clock_gate
cargo fetch --locked

steps.name: Execute owned Rust stack transforms and TLS source reference
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_rust_tls_reference
cargo test --locked -p latent-component-threading --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-stack-transform"
cargo test --locked --manifest-path sdk/rust-standard-runtime/stack-transform/Cargo.toml --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-stack-transform"
python3 tools/run_rust_tls_reference.py --rustc "$(rustup which rustc)" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-tls-reference"

steps.name: Authenticate actual complete thread component routing
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_rust_thread_routing
cargo build --locked --manifest-path sdk/rust-standard-runtime/stack-transform/Cargo.toml --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-stack-transform"
python3 tools/qualify_rust_thread_routing.py --transformer "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-stack-transform/debug/latent-rust-std-stack-source-transform" --wasm-tools "$(command -v wasm-tools)" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-routing"

steps.name: Build the exact current signed clock test harness
steps.run:
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test clock_admission --no-run --message-format=json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-standard-clock-native.json"
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test clock_admission -- --test-threads=1

steps.name: Execute rebuilt ordinary SystemTime and Instant components
Prove original native stack ownership through physical retirement
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_owned_native_stacks
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib native_stacks::tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture
python3 tools/qualify_owned_native_stacks.py --cargo-inventory "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-standard-clock-native.json" --native-target "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target" --clocks "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-standard-clocks" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/owned-native-stacks"

steps.name: Qualify authenticated canonical child admission and physical retirement
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_owned_native_threads
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib component_threading::tests:: -- --test-threads=1
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib config::engine::tests:: -- --test-threads=1
cargo test --locked -p latent-core --lib activation_runtime::tests::task_support_admission_checks_original_kind_and_liveness_under_the_same_lock -- --exact
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test local_service --no-run --message-format=json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/owned-native-child-native.json"
python3 tools/qualify_owned_native_threads.py --transformer "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-stack-transform/debug/latent-rust-std-stack-source-transform" --wasm-tools "$(command -v wasm-tools)" --cargo-inventory "$RUNNER_TEMP/owned-native-child-native.json" --native-target "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/owned-native-children"

steps.name: Retain bounded standard clock evidence including failures

with.name: rust-standard-clocks-${{ github.run_id }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-clock-native.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-clocks/report.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-clocks/**/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-clocks/**/clock-guest.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-clocks/**/std-sysroot-build.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-clocks/**/BUILD-FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-clocks/**/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-clocks/**/project/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-clocks/**/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/owned-native-stacks/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-tls-reference/reference.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-thread-routing/**
${{ runner.temp }}/owned-native-child-native.json
${{ runner.temp }}/owned-native-children/**

reviewReason: Preserve every existing clock/sysroot/TLS/routing/native-stack command and deadline; add exact host-verifier unit controls plus current signed canonical-child mechanism campaign and bounded evidence.
